findings.Finding: [assumerole_unrestricted] This statement allows sts:AssumeRole on Resource "*", so every role that trusts this identity can be assumed.
findings.Recommendation: Restrict Resource to the specific role ARNs this identity needs to assume.
findings.WhyItMatters: sts:AssumeRole on Resource "*" lets the holder assume every role whose trust policy admits it, so its effective permissions are the union of those roles rather than what this policy lists.
